author: ripgrim
method: Exact upstream paintGradient over an unchanged frozen video frame.

variants.label: Bottom dissolve
variants.description: A fine grey dither wash rising from the bottom and fading into the video.

variants.label: Top dissolve
variants.description: A slightly coarser wash falling from the top edge, with a clear lower board.

variants.label: Side dissolve
variants.description: Larger pixels dissolving from the right edge across the model pieces.

variants.label: Crossed washes
variants.description: Two fine dither fades meet from the bottom and left for a fuller texture.
